sources.title: Agriculture in the United Kingdom 2025 - Chapter 11 Agri-environment
facts: Defra reports estimated UK agricultural greenhouse-gas and air-pollution emissions using the national inventory and notes annual revisions.
Agricultural sector totals and gas shares are national/sector evidence and are not measurements for an individual parcel.

sources.title: Farm Practices Survey February 2026 - Emissions
facts: Defra's England survey reports farmer views and actions related to reducing greenhouse-gas emissions.
Survey responses about practices or intentions do not establish measured emissions for a farm parcel.

sources.title: Enclosed farmland natural capital accounts UK 2026
facts: ONS publishes natural-capital accounts and condition indicators for enclosed farmland, including an agricultural-land emissions indicator.
The bulletin distinguishes agricultural activity emissions from the greenhouse-gas regulating service associated with land-use change.

sources.title: Mapping greenhouse gas emissions and removals for LULUCF web accessible
facts: DESNZ explains spatial mapping of LULUCF greenhouse-gas emissions and removals within the 2005 to 2024 local and regional statistics.
Mapped LULUCF estimates and peatland or land-use categories require explicit spatial binding before any parcel attribution.

sources.title: Energy Trends June 2026
facts: DESNZ Energy Trends is an accredited quarterly bulletin covering major aspects of UK energy.
Energy production, supply and consumption statistics are activity evidence and are not parcel greenhouse-gas measurements without a supported calculation contract.

sources.title: Energy Trends UK renewables
facts: DESNZ publishes renewable capacity, electricity generation and liquid biofuel consumption data.
Renewable capacity or generation is not itself a greenhouse-gas emissions measurement for a parcel.

sources.title: Energy Trends UK electricity
facts: DESNZ publishes electricity generation, supply, consumption and fuel-use tables.
Electricity activity statistics require separate emissions factors and scope rules before any emissions calculation.

sources.title: Energy Trends UK total energy
facts: DESNZ publishes UK overall energy balances of supply and demand.
National energy balances are aggregate activity statistics and cannot be assigned directly to a parcel.

sources.title: Energy Trends UK oil and oil products
facts: DESNZ publishes oil production, refinery activity, trade, stocks and demand statistics.
Oil supply and demand quantities are activity data rather than direct parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: Annual statement of emissions for 2024
facts: DESNZ's seventeenth annual statement sets out the calculation of the 2024 net UK carbon account under the Climate Change Act 2008.
The statutory carbon account is national accounting evidence and does not establish parcel emissions.

sources.title: Annual statement of emissions for 2024 accessible webpage
facts: The accessible statement reports the latest final inventory basis used for the 2024 net UK carbon account and explains future revisions.
Carbon-budget accounting and territorial emissions must remain distinct from site or parcel measurements.

sources.title: Annual statements of emissions collection
facts: DESNZ's collection links annual statutory emissions statements used to calculate the net UK carbon account.
Collection-level statutory accounting records are provenance evidence, not parcel observations.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions final - National Data Library
facts: The National Data Library catalogue provides DESNZ final UK territorial greenhouse-gas statistics and Open Government Licence metadata.
Catalogue and national statistics remain aggregate evidence and do not establish parcel-level measurements.

sources.title: ONS atmospheric emissions greenhouse gases by industry and gas - provisional edition
facts: ONS provides a provisional edition of greenhouse-gas emissions by industry and gas within the environmental accounts.
Provisional environmental-account estimates must remain distinguished from current/final editions and from territorial parcel measurements.

sources.title: CCC Progress in reducing emissions 2026 report to Parliament
facts: The Climate Change Committee's statutory report assesses UK progress using final 2024 and provisional 2025 emissions data plus policy indicators.
CCC assessments, pathways and policy credibility ratings are analytical/statutory evidence and are not parcel measurements.

sources.title: Independent review on greenhouse gas removals government response
facts: DESNZ responded to the independent GGR review and described work on supply, demand, standards and high-integrity removals markets.
Policy commitments and removal-market frameworks are not evidence of achieved physical removals at a parcel.

sources.title: Greenhouse Gas Removals business model
facts: DESNZ publishes proposed commercial frameworks and MRV-related material for engineered greenhouse-gas removal projects.
A business-model contract or methodology framework does not prove that a physical removal occurred at a parcel.

sources.title: UK methane action plan
facts: DESNZ outlines UK domestic and international actions intended to reduce methane emissions.
Policy actions, targets and historic progress summaries must not be treated as parcel methane measurements.

sources.title: Greenhouse gas removals business models consultation
facts: The government consultation and response set out design principles for GGR business models, negative emissions and MRV.
Consultation positions and proposed contract structures are policy evidence rather than observed removals.

sources.title: RTFO statistics 2024 final report
facts: DfT's final 2024 RTFO report contains the complete obligation-year dataset and documents corrections to published values.
Fuel volumes, certificates and reported greenhouse-gas characteristics have transport-fuel scope and are not land-parcel emissions.

sources.title: RTFO statistics 2025 fourth provisional release
facts: DfT reports provisional 2025 renewable-fuel supply based on data available through 27 April 2026 and states the dataset is incomplete.
Provisional fuel supply, RTFC balances and sustainability characteristics must not be promoted to final or parcel emissions.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2025 fourth provisional release
facts: DfT reports provisional 2025 SAF supply based on data available through 27 April 2026 and states the dataset is incomplete.
SAF volumes, certificates and carbon/sustainability characteristics are aviation-fuel evidence rather than parcel emissions.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2025 third provisional release
facts: DfT's third provisional 2025 SAF release is based on data available through 30 January 2026 and is explicitly incomplete.
Earlier provisional editions must not silently supersede later provisional or final publications.

sources.title: RTFO statistics 2026 first provisional release announcement
facts: DfT schedules the first provisional RTFO statistics for the 2026 obligation year for September 2026.
The announcement is future-release metadata and does not contain observed 2026 publication values as of 26 July 2026.

sources.title: SAF Mandate statistics 2026 first provisional release announcement
facts: DfT schedules the first provisional SAF Mandate statistics for the 2026 obligation year for September 2026.
Future release metadata cannot be treated as observed SAF supply or emissions data.
